rationale: No supported optimization is safely applicable to this workflow. The test job already enables uv dependency caching via `astral-sh/setup-uv@v10.3.2` with `enable-cache: true` and `cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"`, which covers the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-download caching pattern. GitHub Actions `strategy.fail-fast` defaults to true, so the Python matrix already cancels remaining jobs on failure (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is effectively present), and required_checks are unverified, so disabling or gating matrix outcomes could weaken required-check coverage. The Bazel-specific patterns (P-LIT-BAZEL-DEPS, P-LIT-BAZEL-INCREMENTAL, P-LIT-BAZEL-PARALLEL) do not apply because the repository uses Python/uv, not Bazel. The synthetic cloudtune scenario evidence (P-LIT-ENV-CACHE etc.) concerns a different workflow that injects CT_PATTERN/CT_POLICY/CT_DATA, which this repository does not use, and its contraindications (mutable dependency resolution, persistent test contamination) are not resolved for this project. Other patterns (cancel-stale, custom timeout, change filtering, schedule suppression) either require CI-service-level changes outside workflow_yaml, lack representative history, or have unverified preconditions. Preserving intended build and test coverage means no change is warranted.
